name: nurvia
description: Deploys the API and both panels as one Node app: /api/v1, /admin and /vendor on one origin

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix backend --omit=dev && npm ci --prefix admin-panel --include=dev && npm ci --prefix vendor-panel --include=dev && npm run build --prefix admin-panel -- --base=/admin/ && npm run build --prefix vendor-panel -- --base=/vendor/
